<!--''''''-->(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスター～ぷっちぐみ{{ruby|ＳＰ|スペシャル}}～''' ''Pocket Monsters ~Pucchigumi SP~'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} series by おりとかほり Kahori Orito. It is an adaptation of [[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]] and briefly summarizes the main events from ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' to ''[[HZ012|The Future I Choose]]''. It was serialized in the ''{{wp|Pucchigumi}}'' magazine in the June / July 2023 issue (released on April 28, 2023) and the August 2023 issue (released on June 30, 2023).
